news.headline: X News: David Dobrik partners with FOMO app, pitches it as stock trading while it is memecoin-focused
news.detail: X news summary: David Dobrik promoted FOMO as an app to buy and sell stocks; critics say the app is for trading memecoins on chains like Solana (copy-trading, ~0.5% fees) and call the stocks label misleading for mainstream fans. Supporters see it as a way to reach his audience without crypto jargon.

news.headline: X News: Trump Media transfers 4,259 BTC (~$343M) to Crypto.com amid Nov 30 debt deadline
news.detail: X news summary: blockchain trackers saw Trump Media move over 4,000 Bitcoin (about $343M) to Crypto.com in two batches this week from wallets labeled as collateral for 2028 convertible notes, emptying most of those addresses ahead of a Nov 30 holder cash-repayment option on ~$1B notes. No sales confirmed; firm still holds roughly 14,139 BTC total. Chatter ties timing to post-midterm stock drops.

news.headline: X News: Trader Ansem turns SOL short loss into profit via Pump.fun callout rewards
news.detail: X news summary: Ansem closed a $1.7M SOL short earlier with a ~$10.8K loss, then shorted ~$1M more on Pump.fun and took about $35K in callout rewards even while the short sat ~$60K underwater. The story frames Pump.fun callout USDC payouts as able to outpace direct trade P&L for top callers.

news.headline: X News: Robinhood CEO Vlad Tenev posts 'The trenches are calling and I must go'

news.headline: X News: Solana Labs launches Leap mobile app for tokenized stocks, ETFs, and crypto
news.detail: X news summary: Leap early access hit iOS TestFlight on 5 Nov (Android soon), built by the Dialect team Solana Labs acquired. Self-custodial swaps via Jupiter, chart news, fee-inclusive P&L; aims beyond memecoins; tokenized stocks restricted in US/UK/EEA; future fees may burn SOL.

news.headline: X News: Trump-linked tokens plunge after Democrats take Congress ($TRUMP over 20%, $MELANIA 14–16%)
news.detail: X news summary: $TRUMP fell over 20% in one day to about $1.25 (down ~98% from its Jan 2025 peak), with $MELANIA down 14–16% and $WLFI down 4–8%, as Democrats prepare probes into family crypto ventures. A Trump Media wallet also moved thousands of BTC this year.

Reactions mixed between praise for honesty and jokes about building the casino then criticizing the slots.
